# Brotula

> Brotula is a roguelike by Octanta Studio about a deep immersion to the very sources of life and water. The player controls a sexless deep-sea explorer. Battles are turn-based duels of brain cells in 3x3 grids, filled with skills that real deep-sea animals use. Genes carry over between dives, skills last for one dive. Made by hand by Dariia Zodcha, from the art to the code; music and sounds by Shvetsb. Languages: English, Ukrainian. First released on mobile in August 2022; playable on mobile and in the browser on PC via itch.io.

The pages below are plain-text references to what is inside the game. Paths are relative to the repository root.

## Game

- [Game page on itch.io](https://octantastudio.itch.io/brotula): where to play Brotula
- [Octanta Studio](https://www.octantastudio.com/): developer website
